description: Destroy one of an organization's release checks by name. Releases that wait only on that check go live without it, so confirm with the user first. Past runs stay on the releases they checked. Destroying a check that is already gone changes nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

check.description: Required. The check's name, as list_checks reports it.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the check belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: destroy_check
title: Destroy a release check
